summary:
A beige-birch, stone-veneered two-storey McMansion (x2..41, z5..25 on a 44x32 lot): a double-height 4-column portico under a tall quartz-trimmed front pediment (centred on x16.5), an octagonal turret bay with a cone at the west corner, and a set-back three-car garage wing with carriage doors, all under one slate hip roof (pitch 0.6, south dormers). There's a big stone chimney on the west end, arched windows with black shutters, a wide concrete drive, lawn with shrubs and a young birch, and a back deck.
Inside: a double-height foyer with a sweeping stair and gallery, office, dining room, open kitchen/family room with a fireplace, and a mudroom on the ground floor; upstairs a primary suite (bedroom, walk-in closet, bath), three bedrooms and a bonus room over the garage.
